title: Represented but Ignored: A Causal Account of Prosodic Underuse in Audio-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.19211v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Human speech is richly expressive, with prosody carrying linguistic and emotional information beyond the lexical content. A capable large audio-language model (audio-LLM) should therefore support expressive speech understanding, not only transcribing what was said but also interpreting how it was said. Yet behavioral evaluations alone cannot reveal why a model fails on prosodic input. An error may reflect loss of acoustic information, incorrect internal interpretation, or failure to use a representation that is already available inside the model. We introduce a stage-specific probe ladder for localizing these failure modes in audio-LLMs. Across four understanding-only audio-LLMs, prosodic information is usually preserved in the audio path and decodable in late LLM states. Yet it is only partially expressed in the model's final response. We test the causal status of this latent representation with targeted hidden-state interventions. Ev

translated_title: 被表征却被忽视：音频语言模型中韵律使用不足的因果解释
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19211v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：人类语言具有丰富的表现力，韵律在词汇内容之外携带了语言和情感信息。因此，一个强大的大型音频语言模型（audio-LLM）应支持表达性语音理解，不仅转录所说内容，还要解读其表达方式。然而，仅凭行为评估无法揭示模型为何在韵律输入上失败。错误可能反映声学信息丢失、内部解释不正确，或未能使用模型中已有的表征。我们引入了一种分阶段探针阶梯来定位音频-LLM中的这些失败模式。在四个仅理解型音频-LLM中，韵律信息通常在音频路径中得以保留，并在LLM后期状态中可解码。然而，它仅在模型最终响应中被部分表达。我们通过针对性隐藏状态干预测试了这种潜在表征的因果地位。
tldr: 本文提出了一种分阶段探针阶梯方法，揭示了音频语言模型中韵律信息虽被保留在潜在表征中，却因未充分利用而导致最终响应表达不足的因果机制。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a stage-specific probe ladder to localize failure modes in audio-LLMs, revealing that prosodic information is preserved in latent representations but only partially expressed due to underuse, with causal interventions confirming this mechanism.
